description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI class, which manages API endpoints related to employee timesheet entries within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for retrieving detailed timesheet entries, updating entries, and handling related metadata and validation rules.
